areas.notes: Tier 2I island, Bornholm. Held: island. bbox/center computed by the qualify run. Hold (dk-quality): island polygon is 15 clusters, not one hiking destination; re-scope into Almindingen, Roe Plantage, Hammeren, Paradisbakkerne, Dueodde. Cirkelstien, SPOR - Folkemødet and Den Grønne Ring are dropped by the relation-gap gate. Needs code (exclusion by id for unnamed relations, or an allowlist-only island mode). Intended display name: Bornholm uden Almindingen. Batch D (2026-10-31): the northern routes now ship as Nordbornholm (ro-plantage-dk with includes). bornholm-dk stays held (needs-rescope) and must not be published next to it; the remainder (Pedersker Jagthus Rød/Gul, Sandflugtsstien, Ekkodalsstien) waits on its own areas.
